name: JV_CODE_COMBINATIONS_GT
description: This global temporary table will be used to store code combination IDs that identify transactions that are determined to be distributable for a joint venture or correspond to an account set.

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the account set that the code combination ids are associated with.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Key flexfield combination type (Asset, Liability, etc).

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this account combination is enabled.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if summary is allowed for this account combination.
